tasks.subject: Task 1: Guest sample source
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A new mouse-input-test-sample.exe guest that creates a window, registers for raw mouse input, presents one static 480x270 frame, and logs every positioned mouse message and raw delta it receives via printf.

**Files:**
- Create: src/samples/mouse-input-test-sample/CMakeLists.txt
- Create: src/samples/mouse-input-test-sample/mouse-input-test-sample.cpp
- Modify: src/samples/CMakeLists.txt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Compiles cleanly with the project's 32-bit MinGW toolchain
- [ ] window_proc handles WM_LBUTTONDOWN/UP/WM_RBUTTONDOWN/UP unthrottled, WM_MOUSEMOVE/WM_INPUT throttled to ~1/100ms
- [ ] main() registers RegisterRawInputDevices, presents one static 480x270 frame, blocks in GetMessageA loop
- [ ] src/samples/CMakeLists.txt registers the new subdirectory
- [ ] Zero effect on macOS desktop build (samples/ only added under WIN32)

**Verify:** i686-w64-mingw32-g++ -O2 -std=c++20 -static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -I src/dxgk-command-protocol src/samples/mouse-input-test-sample/mouse-input-test-sample.cpp -o /tmp/mouse-input-test-sample.exe -luser32 -lgdi32 -> exit 0, file reports 32-bit PE

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/samples/mouse-input-test-sample/CMakeLists.txt", "src/samples/mouse-input-test-sample/mouse-input-test-sample.cpp", "src/samples/CMakeLists.txt"], "verifyCommand": "i686-w64-mingw32-g++ -O2 -std=c++20 -static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -I src/dxgk-command-protocol src/samples/mouse-input-test-sample/mouse-input-test-sample.cpp -o /tmp/mouse-input-test-sample.exe -luser32 -lgdi32 && file /tmp/mouse-input-test-sample.exe", "acceptanceCriteria": ["compiles clean with mingw", "window_proc handles all mouse messages with correct throttling", "registers raw input", "presents one static 480x270 frame", "CMakeLists registration correct"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: SetupView "Boot Input Test" button
tasks.description:
**Goal:** SetupView can boot either bundled guest: default flow unchanged, new "Boot Input Test" button (visible after first successful boot) starts a fresh SogenEmulator against mouse-input-test-sample.exe.

**Files:**
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/SetupView.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] startEmulator(with:guestResourceName:) defaults to "native-gpu-clear-sample", all existing call sites unchanged
- [ ] everBooted state set true after first successful start()
- [ ] "Boot Input Test" button appears once everBooted, stops current emulator, resets state, boots mouse-input-test-sample
- [ ] Builds clean

**Verify:** cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build -> ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **
